title: HNC Revision
shortDescription: HNC Cyber Security flashcards, quizzes and VLSM subnetting practice.
fullDescription:
Revise your HNC Cyber Security units, one card at a time.

HNC Revision brings your class's revision website to your phone, covering seven units: Computer Programming, Professionalism and Ethics in Cyber Security, Computer Networking, Data Security, Networking Technology, Digital Forensics and the Cyber Security Graded Unit.

FLASHCARDS
• 180+ flashcards, filtered by unit, outcome and topic
• Try a hint first, then reveal the answer with references to the ICO, legislation and SQA unit specifications
• Rate each card Confident or Revisit, then go over your rated cards
• Work through rounds so you see every card before any repeats

QUIZZES
• Multiple-choice questions with explanations
• Retry the ones you got wrong, or move on to the next round
• Your latest answers are saved so you can see how you're doing

OUTCOMES
• See how the cards and questions map to each unit's published outcomes, with practice tasks for each one

VLSM PRACTICE
• IPv4 subnetting exercises with step-by-step hints and worked solutions

ACCESSIBILITY
• Read flashcards aloud
• Dyslexia reading mode with extra letter and line spacing
• Dark mode and large text support

Always up to date: the app downloads the latest cards and questions from the revision website, and keeps a copy so it works offline.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.

These are original study prompts to use alongside your lecturer's materials. They are not official SQA assessment questions, and the app is not affiliated with SQA.
